data.one_liner: Flutter package providing customizable weather animation widgets.
data.what_it_does: It offers a collection of ready‑made weather scene widgets (sun, cloud, rain, snow, thunder, wind) that can be used directly or wrapped for custom gradients. Each widget supports optional configuration and JSON‑serializable config classes.
use_when: You need animated weather effects in a Flutter UI
You want a quick, free way to add weather‑themed visuals without creating assets
avoid_when: You need generic animation beyond weather scenes
Your app requires heavy performance‑critical animations on low‑end devices
strengths: Easy to customize via config classes
Free Apache‑2.0 license and web configurator
weaknesses: No built‑in state‑management or advanced animation pipelines
